Resolves #4044

Updates `resources/scss/src/button/Split.scss` so `Neo.button.Split` delegates per-UI (`primary`, `ghost`, `secondary`, `tertiary`) and per-state (`default`, `:hover`, `:active`, `.pressed`, `.neo-disabled`) border rules to `resources/scss/src/button/Base.scss` on its child `.neo-button` elements instead of overriding `.neo-button { border: none; }` and referencing `--button-border-color`, while collapsing the shared inner seam by overlapping `.neo-trigger-button` (`margin-left: calc(-1 * var(--button-border-width))`), raising the hovered/active/pressed half (`z-index: 1`), and defining `--button-border-width` across all five themes (`theme-light`, `theme-dark`, `theme-cyberpunk`, `theme-neo-light`, `theme-neo-dark`).

Evidence: L2 (VDOM UI class projection in `test/playwright/unit/button/Base.spec.mjs`) → L3 required (`#4044` theme × UI × state paint, verified via reviewer Chromium render receipt on PR #20263). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: bounded SCSS update in `resources/scss/src/button/Split.scss` + `--button-border-width` definition in 5 theme files + unit spec in `test/playwright/unit/button/Base.spec.mjs`.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/button/Base.spec.mjs` (`SplitButton delegates per-UI borders to child .neo-button nodes (#4044)`) + Chromium 5-theme × UI × state render receipt on PR #20263 |

## Deltas from ticket
Since `#4055` unified button borders into `--button-border`, `--button-ghost-border`, `--button-secondary-border`, and `--button-tertiary-border` and `#4501` applied `.neo-button-${ui}` directly to both child `<button class="neo-button">` nodes (`this.vdom.cn[0]` and `this.triggerButton.vdom`), removing `.neo-button { border: none; }` and the obsolete wrapper/trigger border declarations in `Split.scss` lets `button/Base.scss` govern all UI/state borders while `Split.scss` overlaps the trigger seam by `calc(-1 * var(--button-border-width))` and elevates the active/hovered/pressed half (`z-index: 1`).

## Commits
- `42342ee937` — `feat(button): support per-UI borders on SplitButton (#4044)`
- `b40003ccfb` — `fix(button): overlap SplitButton trigger seam and preserve interaction borders (#4044)`

All coverage runs in CI (`test/playwright/unit/button/Base.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/checkThemeCoverage.spec.mjs`: 15/15 passing).

## Post-Merge Validation

### 📋 Required Actions

To proceed with merging, please address the following:

- [ ] **RA-1: The main half must paint its full border while hovered, active or pressed.** `border-right: none !important` outranks `button/Base.scss`'s state borders as well as its resting one, so the main half's highlight never gets a right edge (table above). Here is a shape I rendered in all five themes. It keeps the seam to one line at rest and closes the highlight under interaction:
  - Drop `border-right: none !important` and keep its two radius lines.
  - Overlap the trigger by one border width: `margin-left: calc(-1 * var(--button-border-width))` on `.neo-trigger-button`.
  - Raise the half under interaction: `z-index: 1` on `.neo-button:hover`, `:active` and `.pressed`. `.neo-button` is already `position: relative`.

  No `!important` is needed. The width is a theme value: every theme folds it into a shorthand token, and the neo themes route it through `--cmp-button-borderwidth`. So keep `--button-border-width` and define it in all five themes, rather than deleting it from two and hardcoding `1px`.
- [ ] **RA-2: Make the evidence observe the paint.** Drop the SCSS-text half of the new unit test. `toContain('border-right              : none !important;')` passes only while that block keeps its exact column alignment, and it pins the rule RA-1 replaces. Keep the VDOM half: the SCSS relies on both halves carrying `neo-button-${ui}` through a `ui` change. In the body, take `checkThemeCoverage.spec.mjs` off the AC row and name the render as the paint evidence. I'll re-run the render on your repaired head and post its table as that receipt.
